title: Angus & Julia Stone Announce U.S. Tour Dates
summary: The Aussie singers and songwriters will perform fan faves and new cuts from their forthcoming album "Karaoke Bar."
contentText:
Angus & Julia Stone  will return to the United States this September for a stretch of intimate tour dates in support of Karaoke Bar, the Australian sibling act’s seventh studio album .

The Stones will perform fan favorites and songs from Karaoke Bar on their jaunt, which includes a three-night stand at Los Angeles’ Masonic Lodge at Hollywood Forever (Sept. 14, 15 and 16), plus intimate headline performances at Music Hall of Williamsburg in Brooklyn and Racket in New York City, and previously-announced festival spots in Canada.

Written and recorded across Greece, France and Australia,  Karaoke Bar  is due out Sept. 4 via Virgin Music. The new collection is said to be an exploration of music shaped by places and experiences, honed by geography and emotions, and houses the title track and recently-released “Monroe,” a warm and funky observation on love, fragility, and emotional reciprocity.

Angus & Julia Stone have amassed multi-platinum sales, No. 1s and numerous awards in their homeland and enjoyed an international breakthrough with the 2009 song “Big Jet Plane,” from their domestic chart-topping sophomore album  Down The Way.  The track went on to snag five ARIA Awards, including single of the year; won triple J’s annual Hottest 100 poll, and claimed the APRA Music Award for song of the year.

Rick Rubin produced the group’s third, self-titled studio album, from 2014, which went to No. 1 in Australia and cracked the Billboard 200, peaking at No. 54. At the time, the uber-producer described the artists as “truly unique musicians. They are authentic and pure people who do things from the heart. I’ve never worked with anyone like them before.”

Tickets for the U.S. tour go on sale Friday, July 10 at 10:00am local time at angusandjuliastone.com . Check out the dates below.
